arxiv-2108-10581.title: Higher-order ferromagnetic resonances in periodic arrays of synthetic-antiferromagnet nanodiscs
arxiv-2108-10581.creator: V. Yu. Borynskyi, D. M. Polishchuk, A. K. Melnyk, A. F. Kravets, A. I. Tovstolytkin, V. Korenivski
arxiv-2108-10581.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by V. Yu. Borynskyi, D. M. Polishchuk, A. K. Melnyk, A. F. Kravets, A. I. Tovstolytkin, V. Korenivski. We investigate spin dynamics in nanodisc arrays of synthetic-antiferromagnets (SAF) made of Py/NiCu/Py trilayers, where the NiCu spacer undergoes a Curie transition at about 200 K. The observed ferromagnetic resonance spectra have three distinct resonance modes at room temperature, which are fully recreated in our micromagnetic simulations showing also how the intra-SAF asymmetry can be used to create and control the higher-order resonances in the structure.

arxiv-2405-04874.creator: YAGMUR YIGIT 1, MOHAMED AMINE FERRAG 2, IQBAL H. SARKER 3, LEANDROS A. MAGLARAS 1, CHRISTOS CHRYSOULAS 1, NAGHMEH MORADPOOR 1, HELGE JANICKE 3

arxiv-2406-16342.title: Is your benchmark truly adversarial? AdvScore : Evaluating Human-Grounded Adversarialness
arxiv-2406-16342.creator: Yoo Yeon Sung, Maharshi Gor, Eve Fleisig, Ishani Mondal, Jordan Boyd-Graber, [1em] University of Maryland UC Berkeley[1em]
arxiv-2406-16342.description: Abstract Adversarial datasets should validate AI robustness by providing samples on which humans perform well, but models do not. arxiv-2506-23695.title: A linear topological invariant for weighted spaces of holomorphic functions
arxiv-2506-23695.creator: Andreas Debrouwere, Quinten Van Boxstael
arxiv-2506-23695.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Andreas Debrouwere, Quinten Van Boxstael. We study the linear topological invariant ( Ω ) (\Omega) for a class of Fréchet spaces of holomorphic functions of rapid decay on strip-like domains in the complex plane, defined via weight function systems. We obtain a complete characterization of the property ( Ω ) (\Omega) for such spaces in terms of an explicit condition on the defining weight function systems.

pmc-12920681.description: Aim:This systematic review evaluated the effectiveness of proton pump inhibitors (PPIs) in improving manometric parameters in patients with gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) diagnosed with Ineffective esophageal motility (IEM).Background:IEM represents the most common esophageal motility disorder among patients with GERD. pmc-13054954.creator: Zhenyang Guo, Haonan Kang, Zixuan Feng, Xueli Zhang, Jiahao Shi, Jinhao Li, Ziyu Song, Lirun Xiang, Bangjun Gong, Hu Xu, Chaoliang Leng, Guohui Zhou, Qian Wang, Yandong Tang, Tongqing An, Xuehui Cai, Zhijun Tian, Jinmei Peng, Hongliang Zhang

pmc-13061947.title: Expression profiles of transcription factors and aquaporins suggest putative roles in rubber biosynthesis regulation and drought stress adaptation in guayule
pmc-13061947.creator: Huy Phan, Hussein Abdel-Haleem
pmc-13061947.description: In arid regions of the southwestern United States, selecting drought-tolerant crops is essential for sustaining agricultural productivity and resource efficiency. Guayule (Parthenium argentatum Gray), a desert rubber-producing plant, utilizes complex mechanisms to adapt to water-limited environments. Understanding these strategies is important for enhancing drought resilience and maximizing rubber production.
